thread:
Maria: Quick preflight update — ran staging smoke for the release train. Found two flaky tests and one potential cherry conflict.
Chris: Which tests are failing? Can you paste the failing log snippet?
Maria: Failing steps are in integration/job-queue, timeout in `enqueue -> process -> ack` around 4m. Reproducer link: https://ci.redwood/1234/artifacts/reproducer.log
Alex: I noticed increased latency after the backpressure tweak I landed yesterday. I can try reverting that cherry-pick and re-run.
Zane: Which cherry is it exactly? commit hash?
Maria: Cherry-pick on release/rail-2026-03 is `d4a9f3b`. There's also a metrics cherry `e1c2b40` that touches queue/config.go — conflict reported at lines ~42-55.
Emma: I'll hold off on promoting any perf cherrypicks until we clear staging. cc @oncall:eng-releases
Alex: Pushing a revert branch in 5m: `git checkout -b revert/backpressure d4a9f3b && git revert --no-commit d4a9f3b && git commit -m "revert: backpressure tweak"`
Deploy-bot: Started staging deploy for build 789 — https://ci.redwood/1234. Watching logs :eyes:
Chris: Heads up — there is also a perf cherry `c7b8a11` that depends on the metrics cherry. Do not merge it until metrics is green.
Maria: Current blocker: need Alex to land the revert PR and Emma to trigger a fresh staging deploy. If staging still flakes, we fallback the cherry window.
Zane: I can prepare a quick canary diff and run targeted payloads once staging looks stable.
Emma: Staging deploy finished for build 789. Smoke tests running :white_check_mark:
Deploy-bot: Smoke tests summary: 18/20 passed, 2 failures in integration/job-queue. Logs: https://ci.redwood/1234/artifacts/logs/job-queue.log
Alex: Ok, reverting the cherry on the release branch and opening PR: https://git.redwood/revert/456 (will request Emma for review).
Chris: Can someone assign the PR to Emma when it's ready? I'll re-run the PR pipeline after approval.
Emma: Reviewing the revert PR now. Quick FYI: I saw a kernel OOM warning on worker-7 around 10:32 in the infra logs — might be unrelated but worth checking.
Maria: Plan: Alex lands the revert PR, Emma approves, we rerun smoke. If green, proceed with cherry merge window at 16:00 UTC. If still failing, hold window and open rollback ticket.
Zane: I'll prepare canary payloads for 16:15 UTC in case we need to stage canary testing. No infra blockers from my side.
Deploy-bot: Revert PR pipeline passed. New build 795 created.
Emma: Approved PR, re-running smoke on release branch.
Deploy-bot: Release-branch smoke finished: 20/20 passed. Canary scheduled at 16:15 UTC.
Maria: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: 1) add integration/job-queue to flaky-test watchlist, 2) add the cherry PR links to the release notes draft.
Chris: Added job-queue to the flaky watchlist and updated the release notes draft with PR links.
Maria: End of thread.
